title: Staggered variant safeguards and orchestration
creator: Aisha Martinez
description: Implement a flexible staggered-variant orchestrator that supports gradual release patterns (time-based steps, request-count steps, and metric-triggered progression), shadowing, and automated rollback. The engine should express rollout plans as composable stages with guardrails driven by SLOs, error/latency thresholds, and model-quality checks. Goals: 1) Provide an expressive yet audit-friendly rollout config schema, 2) Integrate with Console for visual step scheduling and manual overrides, 3) Emit telemetry for per-step KPIs and decision rationale, 4) Allow durable rollback and safety fencing without requiring new runtime shims.
acceptance_criteria: Schema for rollout plans is defined and documented in the internal spec (supports percentage splits, weighted A/B branches, shadow routes, and conditional step progression)
Runtime supports at least three progression triggers: fixed duration, request count, and metric-based (error-rate or p50/p95 latency) thresholds
Automatic rollback executes within 30s of guardrail breach and emits an auditable event with reason and preceding metric snapshot
Console surfaces active rollout with per-step metrics and permits manual pause/resume/abort with audit trail
E2E test harness reproduces common failure scenarios (latency spike, output quality regression) and validates rollback behavior
Telemetry includes per-step token-cost, latency distribution, error classification, and model variant id for offline analysis
comments: 2025-02-16 - Aisha Martinez: Initial spec uploaded. Key open question: should progression triggers be evaluated in the control plane (Console) or locally at the serving proxy? Favoring control plane for central visibility but need fast reaction time for rollbacks.

2025-02-20 - Liam O'Connor: POC shows control-plane-triggered rollback meets 30s SLA when using a streaming metrics pipeline. Added a short-circuit to runtime to accept immediate abort signals for safety-critical rollbacks.
2025-02-24 - Design review (Sana Gupta): Console UI should show the "decision rationale" for automated steps (metric snapshots) and allow export to CSV for audits. Minor update to design mock.

2025-02-26 - PR feedback (runtime): Need clearer invariants on prefix/KV cache invalidation when switching variants mid-session. Adding a compatibility clause to rollout spec to require variant-compatible KV schemas or forced session drain.

2025-02-28 - QA: Integration tests for shadow traffic confirmed no measurable regression in p50 under mocked load. Added failure-case test where candidate model returns malformed structured output to verify rollback triggers on quality regression.
2025-03-01 - Security: Confirmed no new secret material is required; rollout decisions logged to existing audit pipeline. Asked for an SRE runbook addendum for manual rollback via CLI.

2025-03-02 - Liam O'Connor: Implementation branch merged for orchestration scheduler. Next: wire up Console controls and complete E2E harness for Canary->Abort flows. Assigned to Cycle 2025-W09 for stabilization.
notes: Trade-offs: Centralized progression gives better observability but requires reliable low-latency metrics; local evaluation reduces latency but complicates auditability and versioning.
Risk: If metric ingestion lags, automated progression could make unsafe decisions. Mitigation: conservative default step durations and require minimum sample counts for metric triggers.
Operational: Add synthetic canaries (heartbeat traffic) to surface routing regressions independent from customer traffic patterns.
Telemetry plan: tag all rollout-related metrics with rollout_id, step_id, variant_id, and bucket (control/candidate/shadow)
